`class ModelViewerNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BaseModelNode`](/reference/nodes/basemodelnode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.model` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ModelViewerNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/model/ModelViewerNode.java)

Draws a 3D model that the user turns by dragging and zooms with the wheel, within ranges.

![A textured cube turned the other way, which the mouse can turn and zoom](/captures/catalog-nodes-modelviewernode.webp)

## Description

A drag with the left button turns the model, one degree per 5 design pixels; one wheel notch zooms by `0.04`.
The model moves smoothly toward the requested zoom and rotation.
A requested value outside its range is kept and applied again when the range changes.

## Learn more

- [3D models](/use/learn/going-further/3d-models/#let-the-user-rotate-and-zoom)

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-beforeZoom"></a>

### beforeZoom

`<T extends ModelViewerNode> T beforeZoom(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Pre<T,Double>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before the zoom changes; cancelling the event refuses the change.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-beforeRotate"></a>

### beforeRotate

`<T extends ModelViewerNode> T beforeRotate(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Pre<T,Point>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs before the rotation changes; the value is a point of yaw and pitch.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-init"></a>

### init

`void init(UI ui)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Draws the model at its requested zoom and rotation from the first frame, without moving toward them.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw(double mouseX, double mouseY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Moves the drawn zoom and rotation toward the requested ones, then draws the model.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-mousePressed"></a>

### mousePressed

`void mousePressed(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Starts turning the model on a left press over the node and consumes the press.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-mouseReleased"></a>

### mouseReleased

`void mouseReleased(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Stops turning the model when the left button is released.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-mouseDragged"></a>

### mouseDragged

`void mouseDragged(NodeMouseEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Turns the model with the mouse move.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-mouseScroll"></a>

### mouseScroll

`void mouseScroll(NodeMouseScrollEvent<?> event)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Zooms on a wheel turn over the node and consumes it.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-method-detach"></a>

### detach

`void detach()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span>

Stops a turn in progress.

## Event details

<a id="ModelViewerNode-event-onZoom"></a>

### onZoom

`<T extends ModelViewerNode> T onZoom(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Double>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs after the zoom has changed.

<a id="ModelViewerNode-event-onRotate"></a>

### onRotate

`<T extends ModelViewerNode> T onRotate(EventListener<NodeChangeEvent.Post<T,Point>> listener)` 

Adds a listener that runs after the rotation has changed.

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
